## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [Juli 1941], SZ-AAL/B1.148
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.148
- Datum: 07.1941
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
Dear H. & M., I am happy to know you in Bath, We tend to often of the
Coast/there are more and more moments when I would like to go back
I am a very bad companion for poor Lotte. The idea to wander around for
years always packing and unpacking without any stay, without my books, without
space and service is oppressive for me who is longing with to years for some rest.
Our idea was to go to Brazil, we have even made reservations (four weeks a lead
is necessary - meanwhile there [cause] are a lot of new regulations, exit permits, questions
and questions, our situation is frightfully complicated - in every respect! - being
only visitors here as friendly aliens and perhaps not as naturalized only, on the other
hand we did not immigrate on behalf of the citizenship - 'not fish nor flesh'
as one said in your mothers house and with the obligations and worries of both sides.
Brazil had the advantage that I could stay as long as I wished and have all
possible opportunities; what here will become in case of war is in any case
not agreable, we cannot take a flat and I hate this packing and unpacking, this
life which is contrary to all concentration with its daily decisions and deli-
berations. And I see no end of this for years and years. The only advantage
of my depression is that {it} make me work; here in this little house I have
done more in three weeks on my autobiography as otherwise in three month,
not leaving it from morning to night without to see anybody; in three days
I hope (in the autobiography) to be through the first war - I wish I would
be through the second one in three months! What has become out of me,
the fanatic traveller and passionate globetrotter! I cannot imagine how I
shall continue if in August we have to leave again (we have reader only for
two months; yes, it is in earnest that I sometimes think I would be better
on my table in Bath even if I has only to eat carrots. I am so sorry for
Lotte that I cannot give her brighter hours and only manuscript to copy
and to copy, that I could not give her a quiet life as modest as it may
be. The others here have all settled only we cannot and sometimes I wonder
how this will continue. Now enough of my worries (we have still some others
in stock) and thanks for all your trouble. Please do not bother yourself with
all that you cannot know about all, even myself could not remember everything
The most important remains that you have a quiet summer and that Eva
is happy and healthy there - I feel how you are longing to see her and I
would like to bring you back her as soon as possible. And who can tell what
the next months will bring; my curiosity is satisfied for good events and I would like
to oversleep the next years. Thanks for all, also to love in the better days
kindest regards from yours Stefan
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief von Stefan Zweig. Die Tinte ist violett. Der Text am linken Rand wurde nachträglich hinzugefügt und verläuft vertikal.
Farbskala/Grauskala fuer Archivierung. Überlagert den Text des Briefes.
